notifications_has_recipient.name: notifications_has_recipient
notifications_has_recipient.value: "notifications"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notifications"."role" IS NOT NULL

pending_changes_target_id_matches_operat.name: pending_changes_target_id_matches_operation
pending_changes_target_id_matches_operat.value:
("pending_changes"."operation" = 'insert' AND "pending_changes"."target_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("pending_changes"."operation" <> 'insert' AND "pending_changes"."target_id" IS NOT NULL)

bank_charges_has_parent.name: bank_charges_has_parent
bank_charges_has_parent.value: "bank_charges"."lc_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bank_charges"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL

doc_submissions_discrepant_has_notes.name: doc_submissions_discrepant_has_notes
doc_submissions_discrepant_has_notes.value:
"doc_submissions"."bank_status" <> 'discrepant'
        OR ("doc_submissions"."discrepancy_notes" IS NOT NULL AND "doc_submissions"."discrepant_since" IS NOT NULL)

doc_submissions_realized_has_amount.name: doc_submissions_realized_has_amount
doc_submissions_realized_has_amount.value:
"doc_submissions"."bank_status" <> 'realized'
        OR ("doc_submissions"."realized_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "doc_submissions"."realized_at" IS NOT NULL)

lcs_expiry_after_latest_shipment.name: lcs_expiry_after_latest_shipment
lcs_expiry_after_latest_shipment.value:
"lcs"."expiry_date" IS NULL OR "lcs"."latest_shipment_date" IS NULL
        OR "lcs"."expiry_date" >= "lcs"."latest_shipment_date"

marbim_call_log_tokens_nonneg.name: marbim_call_log_tokens_nonneg
marbim_call_log_tokens_nonneg.value: ("marbim_call_log"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "marbim_call_log"."input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("marbim_call_log"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "marbim_call_log"."output_tokens" >= 0)

rfq_clarifications_answer_has_date.name: rfq_clarifications_answer_has_date
rfq_clarifications_answer_has_date.value: "rfq_clarifications"."answer" IS NULL OR "rfq_clarifications"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL

payables_has_parent.name: payables_has_parent
payables_has_parent.value: "payables"."supplier_po_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payables"."grn_id" IS NOT NULL

payables_paid_has_date.name: payables_paid_has_date
payables_paid_has_date.value: "payables"."paid_amount" IS NULL OR "payables"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL

receivables_realized_has_date.name: receivables_realized_has_date
receivables_realized_has_date.value: "receivables"."realized_amount" IS NULL OR "receivables"."realized_at" IS NOT NULL

cartons_net_within_gross.name: cartons_net_within_gross
cartons_net_within_gross.value: "cartons"."net_kg" IS NULL OR "cartons"."gross_kg" IS NULL OR "cartons"."net_kg" <= "cartons"."gross_kg"

packing_lists_approved_has_signature.name: packing_lists_approved_has_signature
packing_lists_approved_has_signature.value: "packing_lists"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("packing_lists"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "packing_lists"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

third_party_inspections_result_needs_dat.name: third_party_inspections_result_needs_date
third_party_inspections_result_needs_dat.value: "third_party_inspections"."result" IS NULL OR "third_party_inspections"."result_at" IS NOT NULL

order_outcomes_margins_paired.name: order_outcomes_margins_paired
order_outcomes_margins_paired.value:
("order_outcomes"."quoted_margin_pct" IS NULL) = ("order_outcomes"."actual_margin_pct" IS NULL)
          AND ("order_outcomes"."quoted_margin_pct" IS NULL) = ("order_outcomes"."margin_basis" IS NULL)

certificates_expiry_after_issue.name: certificates_expiry_after_issue
certificates_expiry_after_issue.value: "certificates"."expires_on" IS NULL OR "certificates"."issued_on" IS NULL OR "certificates"."expires_on" >= "certificates"."issued_on"
